name: Dubai Style Chocolate Latte
caffeineNote: No figure published; the ingredient list carries both instant coffee and matcha green tea powder
summary: Dubai-chocolate-style latte from VISVITA, a Chimex Produce brand in Covina, California, sold only through Amazon. Its ingredient list runs instant coffee powder and matcha green tea powder over whole milk powder and non-dairy creamer, with cocoa, pistachios and FD&C Yellow No. 5 and Blue No. 1. VISVITA runs no product page for it, so no figure here is brand-published.
